title: Optimal Inference with Black-box Predictions
summary: Powerful black-box predictive models have motivated many proposals for combining observed data with predictions to perform valid statistical inference. Despite this progress, the field lacks a unifying principle that explains how hypothesis tests should integrate data and predictions in a way that is both valid and efficient. In this work, we address this gap in the high-dimensional Gaussian sequence model.
